about: The fixed benchmark of evals/replay.ts: five saved simulated conversations, each replayed from the dreamer's choice of how it should look, so pictures drawn before and after a change to the harness come from the same conversation. Each is the latest saved run of its dream that got past the style choice. The saved conversations live in state/ on the machine that ran them (26 Sep); they are only ever read.

dreams.name: jellyfish-city
dreams.why: Anime: a bright saturated look at sunset, a stranger with a bicycle, a jellyfish as big as a stadium over the city, riding off a roof through the air, the city seen from above. The only saved run of this dream.

dreams.name: crayon-cat
dreams.why: Crayon: a child's drawing, the dreamer as small as a mouse, a cat as big as a bus carrying them up a drainpipe, a garden from the ground and a street of cats from the roof. Its retelling was corrected, so the breakdown is drafted twice. Latest of two saved runs.

dreams.name: office-snow
dreams.why: Watercolour: snow falling indoors and burying an office, colleagues who don't react, a manager who turns into a snowman in his suit, a glowing snowball. The only saved run of this dream.

dreams.name: car-park
dreams.style: d) just as it looked (a black and white film photograph)
dreams.why: Old film: grainy black and white, stairs that never end, a dog that is always already there, rain falling upwards, a car that is a rowing boat, the roof filling with water. Its look was asked about twice before it was chosen. Latest of two saved runs.

dreams.name: sea-school
dreams.style: own) paint that looks like looking through dirty glass
dreams.why: An underwater school in murky blue-green: swimming down a corridor, pupils who are fish, a teacher who turns into an octopus, a bell that rings as bubbles. The look is the dreamer's own words, not one offered. The only saved run of this dream.
